title: PT$^3$: Prototype-Guided Self-Supervised Pretraining for Generalizable mmWave Human Point Cloud Representation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38551v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-source millimeter-wave (mmWave) observations offer an opportunity to learn human representations reusable across sensing tasks. However, sparse detections and multipath effects make these observations unstable, challenging existing point cloud pretraining methods. We propose PT$^3$, a prototype-guided self-supervised pretraining framework for mmWave human point clouds. PT$^3$ represents local states in spatial regions as sparse compositions of shared prototypes and learns their temporal evolution through autoregressive prediction. Observation consistency further stabilizes representations under radar perturbations. After pretraining on unlabeled sequences from multiple sources, the same frozen encoder supports action classification, dense point generation, joint pose estimation, and future motion prediction on datasets not used for pretraining. translated_title: PT³：面向可泛化毫米波人体点云表示的原型引导自监督预训练
translated_abstract: 多源毫米波观测为学习可跨感知任务复用的人体表示提供了机会。然而，稀疏的检测结果和多径效应使这些观测不稳定，给现有的点云预训练方法带来了挑战。我们提出了PT³，一种面向毫米波人体点云的原型引导自监督预训练框架。PT³将空间区域的局部状态表示为共享原型的稀疏组合，并通过自回归预测学习其时间演化。观测一致性进一步稳定了雷达扰动下的表示。在来自多个源的无标签序列上进行预训练后，同一个冻结编码器可在未参与预训练的数据集上支持动作分类、稠密点生成、关节姿态估计和未来运动预测。在这些任务中，PT³均优于所对比的预训练基线方法。
tldr: PT³提出了一种原型引导的自监督预训练框架，通过共享原型的稀疏组合、自回归时序预测和观测一致性约束学习可泛化的毫米波人体点云表示，单一冻结编码器即可支持动作分类、稠密点生成、姿态估计和运动预测等多种下游任务。
en_tdlr: PT³ is a prototype-guided self-supervised pretraining framework that learns generalizable mmWave human point cloud representations through sparse prototype compositions, autoregressive temporal prediction, and observation consistency, enabling a single frozen encoder to support multiple downstream tasks including action classification, dense point generation, pose estimation, and motion prediction.
